meta.note: UI component libraries and UI-adjacent libraries mapped across platforms. Install strings carry no versions. Entries with install 'Built into ...' are platform-provided. Statuses reflect GitHub archive flags, pub.dev discontinued flags, npm deprecation notices and project READMEs checked on 2026-11-02; Compose artifacts are hosted on Google Maven (maven.google.com), others on Maven Central unless marked JitPack.

items.title: Design-system component kit (buttons, text fields, app bars, cards)
items.description: The component set each platform ships or the most common community kit. Android: Material 3 for Compose (Material Components for Views is the XML equivalent); iOS: SwiftUI/UIKit system controls; Flutter: Material and Cupertino widget libraries; React Native: no first-party kit, react-native-paper (Material) is a common choice. Other RN kits include react-native-elements, gluestack-ui and Tamagui.

ios.name: SwiftUI / UIKit system controls
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: Material & Cupertino widgets
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

builtin.android: Material Components for Views (com.google.android.material:material) is the XML/Views counterpart of Material 3 for Compose.
builtin.ios: System controls adopt the current OS design automatically; Apple's Human Interface Guidelines replace Material.
builtin.flutter: Cupertino widgets (https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/widgets/cupertino) give iOS-style controls from the same SDK.

items.title: Adaptive layouts (window size classes, list-detail, navigation suite)
items.description: Layout helpers that switch between bottom bar, rail and multi-pane layouts based on window size. Android: Material 3 adaptive libraries for Compose; iOS: NavigationSplitView and size classes; Flutter: LayoutBuilder / MediaQuery plus NavigationRail; React Native: useWindowDimensions with custom breakpoints.

ios.name: NavigationSplitView / size classes
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: Adaptive & responsive design guide
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

builtin.flutter: The flutter_adaptive_scaffold package is marked discontinued on pub.dev; use the built-in widgets.

items.title: Runtime permission request helpers
items.description: State holders that wrap the platform permission prompt flow. Android: Accompanist Permissions (still published for Compose); iOS has no cross-framework helper, each framework exposes its own authorization API; Flutter: permission_handler; React Native: react-native-permissions.

ios.name: Per-framework authorization APIs
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.android: ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission (androidx.activity) is the platform API underneath.

items.title: Keyboard avoidance & IME insets
items.description: Moving content out of the way of the on-screen keyboard. Android: WindowInsets.ime in Compose Foundation; iOS: keyboard layout guide / SwiftUI safe-area handling; Flutter: MediaQuery.viewInsets and Scaffold resizing; React Native: react-native-keyboard-controller.

ios.name: Keyboard layout guide / safe area
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: MediaQuery.viewInsets
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

items.title: Unstyled / copy-in component primitives
items.description: Behaviour-and-accessibility primitives you style yourself. Android: Compose Unstyled; iOS: plain SwiftUI views with custom ButtonStyle/ViewModifier; Flutter: shadcn_ui is a port of the shadcn/ui look; React Native: gluestack-ui (copy-in components styled with NativeWind). NativeBase, the earlier gluestack predecessor, carries an npm deprecation notice pointing to gluestack-ui.

ios.name: SwiftUI custom styles (ButtonStyle, ViewModifier)
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

items.title: Charts (line, bar, area)
items.description: Declarative chart libraries. Android: Vico (Compose and Views); iOS: Swift Charts, built in since iOS 16; Flutter: fl_chart; React Native: victory-native.

ios.name: Swift Charts
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.ios: Swift Charts needs no dependency; UIKit apps host it with UIHostingController.

items.title: Charts (established View-based libraries)
items.description: Long-standing imperative chart views. MPAndroidChart (Android Views, distributed via JitPack) and DGCharts (formerly Charts, iOS) share an API lineage. Flutter: Syncfusion charts (commercial license terms apply); React Native: react-native-gifted-charts.

ios.name: DGCharts (Charts)
ios.install: https://github.com/ChartsOrg/Charts (Swift Package Manager)

items.title: Lottie vector animations (After Effects JSON)
items.description: Plays Lottie/Bodymovin JSON animations. The same file works on all platforms.

ios.name: lottie-ios
ios.install: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios (Swift Package Manager)

items.title: Declarative UI animation APIs
items.description: State-driven property animations. Android: Compose Animation APIs; iOS: SwiftUI withAnimation / animation modifiers; Flutter: implicit animations plus flutter_animate for chained effects; React Native: react-native-reanimated.

ios.name: SwiftUI animations
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.flutter: Implicit animation widgets (AnimatedContainer, AnimatedOpacity, ...) ship in the SDK: https://docs.flutter.dev/ui/animations
builtin.react_native: The built-in Animated API remains available without extra dependencies.

items.title: Rive interactive animations (state machines)
items.description: Runtime for Rive files with state machines driven by app inputs. React Native has a legacy package (rive-react-native) and a newer Nitro-based runtime (@rive-app/react-native); the legacy repo README points to the new runtime.

ios.name: rive-ios
ios.install: https://github.com/rive-app/rive-ios (Swift Package Manager)

items.title: Confetti / particle celebrations

ios.name: ConfettiSwiftUI
ios.install: https://github.com/simibac/ConfettiSwiftUI (Swift Package Manager)

items.title: Custom 2D drawing (canvas)
items.description: Low-level drawing surfaces. Android: Compose Canvas; iOS: SwiftUI Canvas / Core Graphics; Flutter: CustomPainter; React Native: Skia via @shopify/react-native-skia.

ios.name: SwiftUI Canvas
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: CustomPainter
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

items.title: Image loading & caching
items.description: Async network image loading with memory/disk caches. Android: Coil; iOS: Kingfisher; Flutter: cached_network_image; React Native: expo-image.

ios.name: Kingfisher
ios.install: https://github.com/onevcat/Kingfisher (Swift Package Manager)

builtin.ios: AsyncImage (SwiftUI) loads remote images but does not provide a persistent disk cache beyond URLCache.

items.title: Image loading & caching (long-established alternatives)
items.description: Alternative loaders with a long history. Android: Glide (Views and Compose via the compose artifact); iOS: SDWebImage (with SDWebImageSwiftUI); Flutter: extended_image; React Native: react-native-fast-image.

ios.name: SDWebImage
ios.install: https://github.com/SDWebImage/SDWebImage (Swift Package Manager)

builtin.android: Compose integration: com.github.bumptech.glide:compose. Picasso (com.squareup.picasso:picasso) is another Views-era loader.
builtin.ios: Nuke (https://github.com/kean/Nuke) is another maintained Swift option.

items.title: Photo / media picker
items.description: Letting users choose photos without broad storage permission. Android: Photo Picker via ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia; iOS: PHPickerViewController / SwiftUI PhotosPicker; Flutter: image_picker; React Native: expo-image-picker.

ios.name: PhotosPicker / PHPickerViewController
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

items.title: Image cropping UI
items.description: Crop/rotate screens for user-selected images. Android: Android-Image-Cropper (CanHub fork, published under com.vanniktech); iOS: TOCropViewController; Flutter: image_cropper; React Native: react-native-image-crop-picker.

ios.name: TOCropViewController
ios.install: https://github.com/TimOliver/TOCropViewController (Swift Package Manager)

builtin.android: The original ArthurHub/Android-Image-Cropper repository has not been updated since 2023; the CanHub fork is the actively updated one.

items.title: SVG rendering
items.description: Drawing SVG files at runtime. Android: Coil SVG decoder; iOS: Xcode asset catalogs accept SVG natively, SVGView renders SVG files at runtime in SwiftUI; Flutter: flutter_svg; React Native: react-native-svg.

ios.name: SVGView
ios.install: https://github.com/exyte/SVGView (Swift Package Manager)

builtin.android: Android Studio converts SVG to VectorDrawable at build time, which Compose can load with painterResource.

items.title: Pinch-to-zoom image viewer
items.description: Zoomable/pannable image surfaces. Android: Telephoto; iOS: UIScrollView zooming (built in); Flutter: photo_view; React Native has no single dominant library, so none is listed.

ios.name: UIScrollView zooming
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

items.title: Icon sets
items.description: Icon fonts/vector sets. Android: Material Icons (extended set) for Compose; iOS: SF Symbols; Flutter: Icons class plus cupertino_icons; React Native: @expo/vector-icons (or expo-symbols for SF Symbols on iOS).

ios.name: SF Symbols
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.flutter: Material Icons ship in the SDK as the Icons class.
builtin.react_native: react-native-vector-icons now publishes per-icon-family packages (the monolithic npm package carries a deprecation notice).

items.title: Custom & Google fonts
items.description: Loading non-system fonts. Android: Downloadable Google Fonts in Compose; iOS: bundle fonts and list them in Info.plist (UIAppFonts); Flutter: google_fonts; React Native: expo-font.

ios.name: Custom fonts in apps
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

items.title: Virtualized lists
items.description: Recycling/lazy lists for large data sets. Android: LazyColumn (Compose) or RecyclerView (Views); iOS: SwiftUI List / LazyVStack or UICollectionView; Flutter: ListView.builder (super_sliver_list for very large variable-height lists); React Native: FlashList.

ios.name: UICollectionView / SwiftUI List
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.flutter: ListView.builder and CustomScrollView slivers are built in.
builtin.react_native: FlatList is built in; FlashList is a drop-in-style alternative.

items.title: Declarative data-to-cell list frameworks (Views era)
items.description: Frameworks that build heterogeneous lists from models for imperative UI toolkits. Epoxy (Android RecyclerView) and IGListKit (iOS UICollectionView). Declarative toolkits (Compose, SwiftUI, Flutter, React Native) cover this natively, so those platforms are left empty.

ios.name: IGListKit
ios.install: https://github.com/Instagram/IGListKit (Swift Package Manager)

items.title: Pull-to-refresh
items.description: Swipe-down refresh gesture. Android: PullToRefreshBox in Material 3; iOS: .refreshable / UIRefreshControl; Flutter: RefreshIndicator; React Native: RefreshControl.

ios.name: refreshable(action:)
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: RefreshIndicator
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

builtin.android: Views: SwipeRefreshLayout in androidx.swiperefreshlayout:swiperefreshlayout. Accompanist SwipeRefresh is deprecated.

items.title: Paged / infinite lists
items.description: Loading list data in pages as the user scrolls. Android: Paging 3 with Compose or RecyclerView; iOS has no standard library (SwiftUI List with onAppear triggers and async/await); Flutter: infinite_scroll_pagination; React Native: FlatList/FlashList onEndReached, often combined with TanStack Query infinite queries.

ios.name: List + onAppear + async/await
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

items.title: Drag-to-reorder lists

ios.name: onMove(perform:)
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: ReorderableListView
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

items.title: Date & time pickers

ios.name: DatePicker

flutter.name: showDatePicker

ios.name: Picker
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.flutter: DropdownMenu and DropdownButton are in the SDK.

android.name: State hoisting in ViewModel (Compose text fields)

ios.name: SwiftUI Form / @FocusState

ios.name: sheet + presentationDetents
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

items.description: Transient messages. Android: Material 3 Snackbar; iOS: SwiftMessages (no built-in toast); Flutter: SnackBar (built in) or fluttertoast; React Native: react-native-toast-message.

ios.name: SwiftMessages
ios.install: https://github.com/SwiftKickMobile/SwiftMessages (Swift Package Manager)

ios.name: Menu / contextMenu
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

flutter.name: MenuAnchor
flutter.install: Built into the Flutter SDK (no install)

items.title: Markdown rendering

Android: multiplatform-markdown-renderer (Compose; Markwon for Views); iOS: SwiftUI Text and AttributedString parse inline Markdown natively, swift-markdown-ui renders full documents (its README says it is in maintenance mode); Flutter: flutter_markdown_plus (flutter_markdown is discontinued on pub.dev); React Native: react-native-markdown-display.

ios.name: swift-markdown-ui

ios.note: README states the project is in maintenance mode.

ios.name: RichTextKit
ios.install: https://github.com/danielsaidi/RichTextKit (Swift Package Manager)

items.title: HTML-to-native text rendering

ios.name: MapLibre Native for iOS

ios.name: swipeActions

items.title: Accompanist modules that were deprecated in favour of official APIs
items.description: Accompanist's README lists Navigation-Animation, Navigation-Material and System UI Controller as deprecated and removed. The Pager, SwipeRefresh and FlowLayout module READMEs state they are deprecated because official Compose APIs now exist; the Placeholder README says it is deprecated and unmaintained. Only Permissions, Drawable Painter and Adaptive are listed as current in the README.

android.name: Accompanist Pager / SwipeRefresh / FlowLayout / Placeholder
android.note: Last published modules on Maven Central: 0.36.0 for these artifacts; Permissions and Adaptive reached 0.37.x.

ios.name: Not applicable — SwiftUI ships equivalents
ios.install: Built into the iOS SDK (no install)

builtin.android: Pager -> HorizontalPager/VerticalPager (Compose Foundation); SwipeRefresh -> PullToRefreshBox (Material 3); FlowLayout -> FlowRow/FlowColumn (Compose Foundation); Placeholder -> a shimmer library such as compose-shimmer or a custom modifier.
builtin.ios: TabView(.page), .refreshable and redacted(reason: .placeholder) cover the same needs.
